name: capell-app/inertia-react-adapter
description: React client adapter for Capell Inertia pages, package routes, and adapter-driven themes.

healthChecks.label: Capell Inertia React adapter is registered.

marketplace.summary: Register the React client runtime for Capell Inertia with React/Vite dependencies, a generic application entrypoint, and safe adapter activation.
marketplace.description: Registers React NPM dependencies, the Capell Inertia React application entrypoint, and the react adapter metadata consumed by the shared bridge. Choose it only when your frontend is built with React; it requires Capell Inertia and adds no screens to the admin.
marketplace.problem: Our React theme needs custom bridge wiring before it can render Capell pages.
marketplace.outcome: A React Inertia theme can render public pages using the registered client runtime.

faq.question: Does this add a React editing screen?
faq.answer: The adapter declares no admin page or editor extension.

faq.question: How does the React theme receive its runtime?
faq.answer: The adapter registers a React client runtime and entrypoint with the shared Inertia bridge.

faq.question: Where is content stored with this adapter?
faq.answer: The adapter has no schema impact; persistence remains with Core or required packages.
